comments: 8d484868: ;DEV routine to setup environment for editing VAS EXPORTS CORR file.
bb950e4c: ;Initialize variables for FileMan data environment.
0fc1219f: ;If DT node is present, extract DELTA revision date from 5th piece.
ee0f42f8: ;Clean up temporary variables.
6e43d4b7: Write the prompt and right side of the default.
070c3627: Exit if no further input is required.
c064b6ca: If not in Word-Processing mode, write the 'up-arrow' prompt.
24a83c32: If the field is not Word-Processing and is a numeric type, go to routine to handle numeric responses.
77675e1b: If field is Word-Processing (DV['I']) and doesn't allow editing, display '(No Editing)'.
6f628945: Read the user's response into X, timing out after DTIME seconds.
1f59404d: Exit.
be728a66: Initialize DQ (Data Quality) array and increment DQ counter.
27854c34: Branch to label specified by DQ counter value.
bab2679c: Go to PR label if DE(DQ) is defined, otherwise execute W and TR.
2d6446b3: If X is empty, go to A label if DV doesn't contain 'R', go to X if DV is empty, go to X if D is negative, otherwise go to A.
833a22ce: If X starts with '?', go to QS label. If X contains '^', execute D and branch to ^DIE17.
6534e9bc: If X is '@', execute D and branch to Z^DIE2.
4292d75f: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) exists, set X to its value. If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write '  '_X.

dff32ccf: If DV is defined, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P. If ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) exists, execute it. Set % to the second piece of DU delimited by ';_X_:'. Set Y to X. If % is not empty, execute DIC("S") if it exists. If DB(DQ) is undefined, write '  '_%. Go to V.

80fe24c6: Loop through pieces of DU delimited by ';'. Set Y to each piece and DG to the position of ':_X' in Y. If Y is empty, go to X label. Set YS to Y and Y to the piece before ':'. If DG is true, execute DIC("S") if it exists. Quit the loop if DG is true.
fb5d004e: If DB(DQ) is undefined, write the substring of YS starting from position DG. Set X to the piece of YS before ':'.
8192cc5a: If user exits without entering data, quit.
7be99933: If the data value is numeric only, check that the number of decimal places is valid.
7188fdde: Clean up the data value according to the input mask rules.
c9e89f58: Execute any special code associated with this field.
bd6e85b6: Store the data value if it is valid and not the undefined value.
009383df: ;Branch to handle defaults if DB(DQ) contains data.
75df8305: ;Set X to a bad data flag.
5313d5d0: ;Set DATA (DZ) equal to X and call the DIE-QQ^DIEQ routine to validate the data, then go to label B.
6b8ab585: ;Set DIFLD to D, DQ(DQ) to a string containing the external label (DLB), user's input (DV), and executable help (DU, DW, code for X_DQ).
942131c0: ;If DE(DQ) does not exist, call the O routine. If X is not '@', go to RD. If DV does not contain 'R' and X is '@', go to A. If X is '@', set X to Y and go to N.
d56bf501: ;Set DG to DV, Y to DE(DQ), and X to DU. If DQ(DQ,2) exists, execute it, then go to RP.
f069e59b: Get the help text for a data element subfield if it exists
f07bdb6f: Get the help text for a subfield of a word processing field if it exists
5a6c8faa: Get additional help text from additional help text nodes if they exist
560da793: If not a new entry, quit if the .01 field has a value and if Prompted ('DC'='1') Else, perform DIEZIS^DIE17;1, which creates a new entry.
c314035d: If input transform ('DV') doesn't contain 'I' (internal) or '#' (external), branch to Reader ('RD')
f1d16f7c: Execute input transform logic and branch to Reader ('RD') if variable 'X' is defined; otherwise, continue to Prompt mode ('PR')
7cced0fd: Exit the Reader input code
a30bfa90: Set the name of the input template ('DNM') and the sequence number ('DQ') to 1
780cd545: Set the dialog writer control variables for the DATE SIGNED field (#10.05): default value is null, input transform is 'DX', last value is null, label is 'DATE SIGNED'
a88fe71e: Branch to input Reader mode ('RE')
eef01f63: Execute the KERNEL date/time input routine to get the current date/time in FileMan internal format and store it in 'X'; if the result is before the current date, set 'X' to null
e6d44edf: Exit the X1 input transform code

5427ea7d: If the DG array is defined (input data was passed), execute the FLDCC^DIE17 code to process the data. Otherwise, execute the input transform ('DE') for the DATE SIGNED field. Set 'Y' to null and set 'DQ' to 2. Execute the X2 input transform code. If 'Y' is null or equal to null, branch to Reader mode ('A'). Otherwise, set 'X' to 'Y', set 'DIC(0)' to 'F' (field-only edit), set 'DW' to 'DQ', and execute the OUTROOT^DIE17 code to update the field value.
cfd9cccd: If no date entered, clear the TRANSCRIBED field.
4fba6844: Quit routine.
78ebe037: Run standard input transform routines on DATE TRANSCRIBED field.
4db3333b: If date entered is before the DATE DICTATED value, display an error message and clear the TRANSCRIBER INITIALS field.
3f31ed81: Quit routine.
e1195c90: Run standard input transform routines on TRANSCRIBER INITIALS field.

f46425ab: ;Exit/Quit the routine.
